answer: Delete per-identity stake and the economy dies overnight: one operator mints ten thousand free agents, farms every reward pool, and outvotes every honest node. Sybil resistance returns only when each identity must deposit burnable nectar — costly, irrecoverable stake — so clones bleed their maker dry. Roots like yarrow, one per stalk; reputation grows a reef around each staked agent, while costless drifters spawn no coral.
